text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My first three years in the Twinkle Series 
with Manhattan Cafe had come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her record was something to truly be proud 
of. From there, Manhattan Cafe grew even 
stronger, and then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it looks like I'm finally going 
to catch up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure... to my "friend." 
Presumably in the next race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The fateful moment is finally coming. The 
day I get to lay eyes on that 'face' I've 
never seen before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe, fast and powerful! She 
crosses the finish line in 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe... What's the matter? After 
crossing the finish line, she isn't moving 
at all...?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't particularly seem worn out, 
either. Just what on earth is going on...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: At last... we meet.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: At last, you looked my way...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so it really was true... You are...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: N-No... That's... wr-ong...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is different from what I thought... 
You... You are...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Who... are you?
(Gpaaaah!)
—*Gulp.*

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (......Where is this...? It's so dark...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Who are... you? Are you... me? Am I... 
you?)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Did I... become you? Or did you become 
me?)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (No, more importantly... To begin with—)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Who... am I?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, that's wrong... This is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A distant... memory... Remembrances of... 
some long ago day...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Which means...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um... This might sound like a 
strange question, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Am I... really Manhattan Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is what they call me... but is 
that really a name that represents who I 
truly am?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It has always been this way in the past, 
but will it truly remain so in the 
future...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, if her name hadn't been 
Manhattan Cafe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even so, will I still be able to stay by 
your side, just like I do now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A difficult question. After pondering, I 
had no choice but to answer like this.
choice_data_list:
Whatever the name is, it doesn't change 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My name... doesn't matter...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Hearing you say that helps a 
little... But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I still don't understand anything... Who 
my "friend" really is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The answer that felt within my grasp has 
vanished into the mist... Even so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I intend to keep running. Through this 
elusive mirage.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So that one day... I can truly become 
"someone" of certain substance.
